name: setfsgid
description: setfsgid() sets the filesystem group ID of the calling process, allowing it to differ from the effective group ID for filesystem permission checks. It succeeds only if the caller is the superuser or if the specified ID matches the real, effective, saved set-group-ID, or current filesystem group ID.

parameters.name: fsgid
parameters.description: The new filesystem group ID to set

return_value.success: Returns the previous filesystem group ID
return_value.failure: Returns the previous filesystem group ID

errors.description: Invalid argument, such as when the argument cannot be passed to the kernel without truncation
The caller lacks the necessary permissions (though not actually returned by the system call)

bugs: No error indications are returned, making it impossible to determine if the call succeeded or failed; the caller must use additional calls to verify changes.
